description:
APPLICATION FOR ADVERTISEMENT CONSENT FOR THE PROPOSED
INSTALLATION OF SIXTEEN RAPID ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGING STATIONS AND ANCILLARY
EQUIPMENT WITHIN THE CHAPTER WAY CAR PARK, INCLUDING FOUR FULLY ACCESSIBLE EV
CHARGING BAYS.
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Owner's Permissio</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">n - No advertisement is to be displayed
without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an
interest in the site entitled to grant permission.</span><o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">:&nbsp; To accord
with Regulation 14 of the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements)
(England) Regulations 2007.</span></p>

<p style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size: 14px;"><u>﻿</u></span><span style="font-size: 14px; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Hazards</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to endanger
persons using any highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil
or military), obscure or hinder the ready interpretation of any traffic sign,
railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air, or hinder the operation of
any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring
the speed of any vehicle.</span></span></p><p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:" arial",sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:="" minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:en-gb;mso-fareast-language:en-us;mso-bidi-language:="" ar-sa"=""><span style="font-size: 12pt; line-height: 107%;"><span style="font-size: 14px;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason:</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">&nbsp; </span></span><span style="font-size: 14px;">To accord with Regulation
14 of the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements) (England)
Regulations 2007.</span></span></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal">No below ground works relating to the advertisements hereby granted consent shall commence until a Heritage Statement has been submitted to and approved in
writing by the Local Planning Authority. The assessment shall be prepared by a
suitably qualified heritage professional and shall:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal">a) identify and
assess the significance of all designated and non-designated heritage assets
that may be affected by the development, including any Scheduled Monument and
its setting;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal">b) assess the
likely impact of the proposed works upon the significance of those heritage
assets; and<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal">c) identify any
measures required to avoid, minimise or mitigate harm to heritage significance.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal">The development
shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details.<o:p></o:p></p><p>









</p><p><span style="font-size:11.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:&quot;Aptos&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-ascii-theme-font:minor-latin;mso-fareast-font-family:Aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:
minor-latin;mso-hansi-theme-font:minor-latin;mso-bidi-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;
mso-bidi-theme-font:minor-bidi;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:
EN-US;mso-bidi-language:AR-SA">Reason: To ensure the significance of heritage
assets is properly understood and conserved, and to safeguard the historic
environment in accordance with London Plan Policy HC1 and the policy D12.5 of
the Merton Local Plan.</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal">No works relating to the display of the advertisements hereby granted consent,
including any ground disturbance, excavation, demolition or site clearance
works, shall commence until:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal">b) a Written
Scheme of Investigation (WSI) for archaeological monitoring, prepared by a
suitably qualified archaeological contractor, has been submitted to and
approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal">The WSI shall
include details of archaeological monitoring, recording, reporting, archiving
and publication. The approved scheme shall be implemented in full and the
development carried out in accordance with the approved details.</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal"><br></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;line-height:normal"><o:p></o:p></p><p>





<span style="font-size:11.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:&quot;Aptos&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-ascii-theme-font:minor-latin;mso-fareast-font-family:Aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:
minor-latin;mso-hansi-theme-font:minor-latin;mso-bidi-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;
mso-bidi-theme-font:minor-bidi;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:
EN-US;mso-bidi-language:AR-SA">Reason: To ensure that archaeological remains
and the significance of the Scheduled Monument are appropriately protected,
investigated and recorded in accordance with London Plan Policy HC1 and the
policy D12.5 of the Merton Local Plan.</span></p>
